errors.text_span: Teacher方法在0.0至0.5处退化率均为0.0
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. While the degradation rate is very low in this range, it is not uniformly 0.0. The red line shows a visible, albeit slow, increase from a rate of 0 at x=0 to a rate of approximately 0.04 at x=0.5.
The degradation rate for the Teacher method (red line) at a missing label rate of 0.6 is approximately 0.08, not 0.02. The stated value is significantly lower than what is shown in the plot.

This is incorrect. The degradation rates for Self-Training and PST are not uniformly 0.0 in this range. The lines show a visible, slow increase. For example, at a missing label rate of 0.5, both methods have a degradation rate of approximately 0.04.

The degradation rates at a missing label rate of 0.6 are incorrect. For Self-Training (blue), the rate is approximately 0.06, not 0.01. For PST (green), the rate is approximately 0.05, not 0.02. The stated values are significantly underestimated.
The degradation rate for the Teacher method at a missing label rate of 0.9 is approximately 0.88, which is much closer to 0.9 than to 0.8. The stated value is a significant underestimation.
The degradation rate for the Self-Training method (blue line) at a missing label rate of 0.7 is approximately 0.12, not 0.08. The stated value is too low.
The degradation rate for the PST method (green line) at a missing label rate of 0.7 is approximately 0.1, not 0.05. The stated value is half of the actual value shown in the plot.
